title: Matveev-Beal Level 26: Rank-3 B0/C cutoff nogo
description: Tag v24-v24x-final-rank3-b0-div-c-nogo on foundations-level-26 (GitHub slug beal-level-26-foundations, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22379293). Prior tag v24-v24x-final-rank3-shape-nogo stays at c1d173e. C1_floor=143186215390. B0_nat=1000000. C_LLL_v25=C1_floor (not C1^2). Separate Lake target BealMatveevBealV25Rank3 wraps the shipped rank-3 lattice of MatveevLLL.lean: v = 4 b1 − 13 b2 encodes Lambda = 4 log A − 13 log(B+3); on a gap-3 solution with B > B0 one has ‖v‖ < 32 (a short vector, not a B ≤ B0 cutoff). B0/C > 1/B is true arithmetic (B0_div_C_gt_inv_B). On a solution |Lambda| < 1/B < B0/C, so |Lambda| ≥ B0/C fails (lll_B0_div_C_lower_bound_fails). lambda1 < 32 < B0, so a vector of scale C|Lambda| < B0 is long versus lambda1. Theorems: gap3_B_lt_A_of_sol (B < A), abs_Lambda_lt_inv_B (|Lambda| < 1/B), lll_short_vector_of_large_B, B0_div_C_gt_inv_B, lll_B0_div_C_lower_bound_fails, future_unconditional_shape (by_cases implication). LLL_reduces_bound_to_B0 / LLL_reduces_bound_to_B0_v25 / hGen / hLLL stay uninhabited def Prop. Does not claim Euclidean length ≥ B0 or |u α + v| > exp(−B0) (those are lll_euclidean_lower_bound_fails and lll_form_lower_bound_fails). Does not import MatveevThm14General from the Rank-3 root module. Default lake build BealMatveevBeal stays 0 sorry and does not glob the Rank-3 file. Does not mint v25.0.0-Beal-44-13-Level-26-Baker-B0-Unconditional-foundations. Prior v24.4.0 version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22732209. Series concept 10.5281/zenodo.22379293.
